about: Kyr's judgement of each Orsino rule feature. faithful: same meaning as the Orsino source. adapted: Kyr executes a related mechanic whose different semantics are documented here. cosmetic: no mechanical effect in Orsino. unsupported: no executable Kyr meaning. Features not listed are unsupported. A trailing * matches a prefix.

damage:piercing: Typed Kyr damage. Resistances do not add: Kyr takes the strongest applicable resistance, and piercing falls back to broad physical resistance.
damage:fire: Typed Kyr damage; strongest resistance rather than Orsino's additive resistAll + resistFire.
effect:damage: Kyr typed damage effect. typed-v1 applies power and flat armor to the first physical component; Orsino applies bonusDamage, multipliers and resistances inside handleHit.
effect:heal: Kyr heal clamps to missing HP. Orsino's minimum of 1, bonusHealing and mayBeHealed are not modelled.
effect:buff: Kyr apply to an ally of a catalogued status. Inline Orsino status objects must first be catalogued as Kyr statuses.
effect:debuff: Kyr apply with an explicit save. Orsino's debuff DC is (saveDC or 15) + bonusSpellDC + caster level against a save category.
effect:removeStatus: Kyr remove by status id. Orsino matches by status name or pattern.
effect:attack: Kyr typed attack: d20 + statMod against a fixed authored defense, natural 1 and 20. Orsino uses level-based THAC0 against the defender's armour class, Dexterity, evasion and toHit.
effect:drain: Kyr drain heals the actor by the necrotic damage actually dealt.
effect:kill: Reduces a living target to zero hit points.
effect:resurrect: Kyr revive restores a rolled amount of HP; Orsino hpPercent and template application are not modelled.
effect:gold: Kyr gain of the gold resource.
effect:xp: Kyr gain of the experience resource.
effect:learn: Kyr learn adds a catalogued ability permanently.
effect:summon: Legacy encounter-local summon of a catalogued creature; no persistent campaign ownership.
flag:saveDC: Kyr explicit save difficulty. Orsino adds the caster's level and bonusSpellDC.
flag:saveForHalf: Kyr save.success: half halves the prepared component. Orsino offensive spells roll one save versus magic at DC 15 + bonusSpellDC before all effects.
flag:saveNegates: Kyr default save negates the effect.
target:enemies: Every living opponent in the encounter. Kyr battles are not spatial.
modifier:saveVersusAll: Kyr status save bonus applies to every Kyr save.
modifier:bonusDamage: Kyr power: added once to the first physical component per target under typed-v1. Orsino adds bonusDamage to every hit.
modifier:noActions: Kyr skip: the owner's combat turn is skipped.
modifier:resistFire: Signed fractional resistance, floored, before flat armor; strongest source wins instead of Orsino's sum.
weapon:natural: Natural weapons are creature abilities; they cannot be dropped, sold or equipped.
field:backgroundModifier.str: Added to the generated score, as Orsino's overlay addition.
field:backgroundModifier.gp: Kyr divides Orsino gold by ten for its local coin economy.
field:backgroundModifier.requiredClass: Validated at creation; a character of another class cannot take the background.
field:backgroundModifier.startingGear: Item instances in the character's pack, where the gear kind exists in the Kyr item catalog.
field:classModifier.hitDie: Kyr hit points: hit die + 1d4 + statMod(constitution) + per-level gain. Orsino: hit die + max(0, statMod(con)).
field:masterWeapon.type: Exact damage type where Kyr has the type.
field:masterEquipment.type: The damage type of weapon-class equipment (exact where Kyr has the type); a catalog grouping otherwise.
field:masterEquipment.effect: Judged by the modifier features of the effect.
save:poison: Kyr category save: d20 + statMod(the category's Orsino attribute) + level + saveVersusPoison + saveVersusAll against the difficulty; immunity succeeds; a fourth success per encounter fails. Kyr statMod divides by 3, Orsino's by 2. The difficulty is authored per effect.

field:monsterStat.*: Composed by OrsinoMonsters exactly as the monster template does; the resulting scores are used with Kyr's statMod.
field:monsterTypeModifier.*: As monsterStat; overlay traits become passive traits.
field:monsterXp: Kyr encounterXp of the installed creature.
field:monsterTraits: Passive traits of the creature kind; each trait is judged by its own features.
field:monsterAbilities: Abilities of the creature's calling; each ability is judged by its own features.
field:monsterWeapon: A natural weapon becomes a creature ability.
field:dragonColors.weapon: The colour's breath weapon replaces the natural weapon, as in the template; see weapon:breath.
field:monsterKind: Names the types a monster class can take.
field:monsterTypeClass: Links a type to its class.
field:monsterRank.maxHp: The template overlays a maxHp field that Orsino's combatant never reads; hit points are unchanged.
field:monsterRank.ac: Overlaid as an ac field that Orsino's combatant never reads.
weapon:breath: Orsino never reads this flag: breath weapons attack one target through melee. Kyr makes a breath weapon an area effect on every opponent, with a breath-category save for half and a recharge.
field:golemSubstances.*: Applied by OrsinoMonsters as the substance overlay, in template order.
